endpoint.description: Ordinary Antfly API base. Local catalogs require an absolute HTTPS/loopback URL; the Cloud adapter pins the relative db/v1 reference to its instance context.

principals.description: Additional client-side reader filtering, never server authorization.

subject.description: Authenticated identity for paginated remote discovery.

discovery_id.description: Generation binding all remote discovery pages to the same authorized view.

filter.description: Selection constraint applied through the normal query filter; grants no authority.

valid_until.description: Optional Unix-second readiness/permission lease checked before requests.

access_id.description: Optional server-specific access-view precondition, never a capability.
